scope: Actual both-sign cubic projected references and intrinsic Gaussian-weighted one-face reference masses

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_selectorFaceNormal_neg
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (f : RectangleCLT.Face p),
  RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal (-A) f = -RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A f

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_negative_scale_factor
endpoints.expanded_type: ∀ {p r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (σ : ℝ), -σ • -A = σ • A

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_negative_cubic_mean_reference_bound_all
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p r K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (v : RectangleCLT.Vector p) (σ : ℝ)
  (α : Fin (K + 1) → RectangleCLT.Face p),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0)) = 1 →
    RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHCubicMeanEnergy s (σ • A) v α
        (-RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0)) ≤
      ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
          RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPositiveDirection (-RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0)) g *
              RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α ((σ • A).mulVec g + v) *
            RectangleCLT.faceDot (-RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0)) g ^
              2 ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r +
        (2 *
            RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) fun g =>
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPositiveDirection (-RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0))
                  g *
                RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α ((σ • A).mulVec g + v)) *
          Real.log
            ((∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPositiveDirection (-RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0))
                    g *
                  RectangleCLT.Companion.oneFaceReference s (α 0)
                    ((σ • A).mulVec g + v) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) /
              RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) fun g =>
                RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPositiveDirection (-RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0))
                    g *
                  RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α ((σ • A).mulVec g + v))

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_gaussianWeightedOneFaceMass
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (M : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) {C₀ δ κ : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C₀ →
        0 ≤ κ →
          δ ≤ s.bandwidth →
            RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →
              ∀ (B : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
                Measurable B →
                  (∀ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), 0 ≤ B g) →
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable B (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) →
                      ∀ (f : RectangleCLT.Face p),
                        ∫ (ω : Ω),
                            ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                              B g *
                                RectangleCLT.Companion.oneFaceReference s f
                                  (V ω + M.mulVec g) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r ∂μ ≤
                          4 * C₀ * s.bandwidth * κ * ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), B g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_integrable_positiveDirection
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u : RectangleCLT.Vector r),

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_integral_positiveDirection_le_one
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
    ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
        RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPositiveDirection u g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r ≤
      1

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_positiveOneFaceMass
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (M : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) {C₀ δ κ : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C₀ →
        0 ≤ κ →
          δ ≤ s.bandwidth →
            RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →
              ∀ (u : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
